# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Digital 101 Official
The user wants to build a store website inspired by Stan.store — a creator-focused platform that allows selling digital products, courses, and services. The goal is a clean, conversion-optimized storefront similar to what Stan.store offers for creators and entrepreneurs.

## Target Audience
- Digital Content Creators
- Online Instructors
- Independent Artists
